'''Kandria A'Daasha''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and the co-owner of the [[Glow Dome]] nightclub, located on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]], along with her [[Twin/Legends|twin]] sister [[Corinna A'Daasha|Corinna]]. She was secretly being preyed upon by [[Ziakas]], a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Derriphan (creature)|creature]] that was devouring her very essence.

==Biography==
Kandria and her [[Twin/Legends|twin]] sister [[Corinna A'Daasha|Corinna]] were born into a wealthy family that provided for all their needs. As children, they never struggled for anything, and although her sister Corinna became bored and restless by a life of luxury, Kandria enjoyed her childhood using her economic freedom to fund lessons in dancing, singing, and musical instruments. When Corinna left home to explore the galaxy, separation did not suit either sister, and shortly afterwards Kandria joined her sister in their journey through the stars.<ref name="WHSV" />

It was Kandria's idea to travel to the pleasure planet of [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]] and finally the twins found a site that suited both of their personalities. Although it was both their ideas to open up the nightclub, the [[Glow Dome]], the day-to-day operations have fallen almost entirely on Corinna as Kandria spent her time entertaining and partying.
A dangerous [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] creature, a [[Derriphan (creature)|Derriphan]] known as [[Ziakas]], attached itself to Kandria and had begun feeding upon her thoughts and essence. Kandria attributed the fatigue as caused by too little sleep and too much partying but the truth was much more horrific. If left to feed upon Karinna the Derriphan would have drained her to an empty husk in less than a month.<ref name="WHSV" />

==Personality and traits==
Kandria was far more wild and free spirited than her sister. In fact, the two were almost opposites. Both sisters had a mischievous streak but while Corinna's antics were harmless, Kandria would often get herself into bad situations that resulted in her more practical sister coming to her rescue. Kandria could also be cruel and had a tendency to go through boyfriends very quickly. She wore her long, curly blonde hair in elegantly styled hairdos, and she always made sure to keep up with the latest fashions, taking pride in her wardrobe collection, often selecting pieces that she felt accentuated her features, including expensive [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] and jewelry, especially her bright azure cloak that matched the exact shade of her eyes. [[Cohden K'Reye]] felt that she was physically attractive.<ref name="WHSV" />

==Skills and abilities==
Since an early age, Kandria was given music, singing and dancing lessons, and she excelled in nearly all of them. This started her interest for performing, and she kept doing so, mostly in the [[Glow Dome]]. She also considered acting in [[Holovid/Legends|holovids]]. She was fairly skilled with [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] as well.<ref name="WHSV" />

==Equipment==
Kandria carried two [[Model Q4 hold-out blaster pistol|Quickfire-4]] [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blasters]].

==Behind the scenes==
Kandria A'Daasha was designed by [[Paul Danner]] and [[Bill Smith]] for ''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1997]]. She was illustrated by [[Tom O'Neill]].
